status_results.unknown_status: typed decode failure; no successful result

schema_contract.rows: array of stable rowKey plus raw JSON values addressed by fieldRefs; no display string is authoritative

rules: Formatted display strings are not semantic values.
Zero, false, null, empty and absent remain distinct.
Money requires a native currencyField; digits are present only when the current record supplies an authoritative currency precision fact.
Percentage and duration require an explicit componentKey and unit.
Relations preserve record identity and authoritative label.
Selection preserves the storage key.
Datetime preserves type and timezone authority.
Attachment values reference a fact and role, not a count.

Field identity, type, widget, component key, selection, relation, digits and currency field are consumed from the canonical ContractV2Widget descriptor; page-block-data does not define a parallel field descriptor.

work_packages.title: Attachment Identity and Role
rules: Attachment identity is never a label, count or URL-shape inference.
storageOwner and businessOwner are independent and are never collapsed.
AuthorizationSubject is per-action and server-only; it is never copied into attachmentFacts or page-block-action public payloads.
The frontend must not provide, receive or override authorizationSubject.
Role vocabulary is context-owned; P0 owns only the carrier shape.
Preview/download/delete reference P0-C actions.
Existing file services remain authorization and execution authorities.
Failure identity comes from P0-C execution feedback.
consumer_boundary: Page Block attachment surfaces in FCF-02-2

work_packages.title: Page Block Action and Feedback

schema_contract.feedback_location: runtimeContract.actionFeedback or equivalent runtime action-patch envelope

declaration.label: display label
declaration.permission.evaluated: all required action authority sources were evaluated
declaration.permission.allowed: server-computed compatibility aggregate: target resolved and authorization and business availability permit the action; never an independent frontend input
declaration.permission.authorizationAllowed: actor authorization result only: ACL, record rules and action entitlement
declaration.state.enabled: server-computed final execution state; may be narrower than allowed, but enabled=true requires allowed=true

rules: Visibility, actor authorization, business availability, compatibility allowed and final enablement are distinct.
allowed is a producer-computed compatibility aggregate, not an authorization fact and never a frontend input.
enabled is the final server-produced execution state and must not be recomputed by the frontend.
The internal authorizationSubject remains server-only and is not serialized to the frontend.
Missing permission evaluation fails closed.
Page Block actions reference canonical ContractV2ActionRule actionIds.
target equals the complete existing ContractV2ActionRule target validated by action_target_schema.py.
Block-local target invention and open_scene fallback are forbidden.
Feedback must correlate to the action ID.
Existing action services remain execution and authorization authorities.

cross_carrier_invariants: One declaration owns each business fact.
Display strings never reconstruct business semantics.
Null, empty, zero, false and absent are distinct.
Currency and timezone come from authoritative context.
Relation and attachment identity are independent from labels.
Read-only rendering produces no business write.
No frontend default action target or default unit.

P0-A: money zero and negative with matching currency context
money without an observed currency precision keeps the native currency binding and does not invent digits
percentage 12.5 preserves precision and is not clamped
duration consumes declared unit and does not round
date and datetime with authoritative timezone
attachment value references a fact and role
widget-backed descriptor reference resolves through the existing widget
non-widget computed fact resolves through block_field_descriptors without a fake widget
legacy display-only block required semantics fails closed
P0-B: same attachment fact across form, timeline and One2many
multiple roles on the same owner record
download denied with reason and trace
preview unsupported while download remains allowed
forged Authorization Subject is not accepted as authority
public attachment and action payload excludes Authorization Subject
text URL does not create attachment behavior
ordinary integer does not become attachment identity
P0-C: successful execution with actionId and traceId
denied execution with reasonCode message traceId
failed execution with reasonCode message traceId
no open_scene or local target fallback
